newsitem.title: UK: Russians offering stockpiled magnesium - trade.
newsitem.headline: Russians offering stockpiled magnesium - trade.

text.p: Around 4,000 tonnes of Russian stockpiled magnesium is been offered to the market, European traders said on Monday.
"I have been asked to make a bid for the material...I believe other traders have been also approached," one trader said.
He said there could be another 10,000 tonnes of metal available from the Russian stockpile.
This could severely damage sentiment in magnesium which is already suffering from over supply, traders said.
"Prices are already sagging...further arrivals of metal would send prices significantly lower," one trader commented.
Russian magnesium is currently around $2,400 a tonne
Magnesium is a metal similar to aluminium and is used in alloy form to make castings for the aircraft and automobile industries.
